    StartersPork and sage sausage rollsPuff pastry rolls of pork mince, onion and sageHow to make it500g pork mince1 brown onion, grated1/4 cup sage, chopped1 tsp salt2 sheets of puff pastry, thawed1 egg, beaten2 tbsp English mustardMix the pork with the onion, sage and salt.Halve the pastry sheets and lay the filling along each piece, then roll up and seal.Brush with beaten egg and cut into pieces.Bake at 200°C until golden and cooked through.Serve hot with English mustard.Maximus's crisp apple and fennel saladShaved apple, fennel and celery with toasted walnuts, rocket, cheddar and honey mustardHow to make it3 crisp red apples1 fennel bulb1 bunch celery, inner stalks and leaves80g walnuts100g rocket1 lemon3 tbsp olive oil1 tsp honey1 tsp wholegrain mustard80g aged cheddar, shavedToast the walnuts in a dry pan until fragrant, then chop roughly.Whisk the lemon juice, olive oil, honey, mustard and a pinch of salt.Thinly slice the apples, fennel and inner celery stalks and toss straight into the dressing.Fold through the rocket and celery leaves, then top with the walnuts and shaved cheddar.MainsMother Gothel's hazelnut soupPotato and toasted hazelnut soup with celeryHow to make it150g hazelnuts1 brown onion, diced2 celery sticks, diced30g butter400g potatoes, diced1 L chicken stock150ml thickened cream2 tbsp chives, choppedToast the hazelnuts and rub off the skins.Soften the onion and celery in the butter.Add the potatoes, most of the hazelnuts and the stock.Simmer until the potato is soft.Blend smooth and stir in the cream.Top with crushed hazelnuts and chives.Flynn's smoulder smoked paprika chickenFlynn Rider trying out the smoulderHow to make itAs written, serves 4Chicken spatchcocked and rubbed with smoked paprika, garlic and lemon, roasted with a smoky char, over crispy potatoes with herby yoghurt.Cut out the backbone of a 1.8kg chicken and press flat.Rub with 2 tsp smoked paprika, 3 crushed garlic cloves, the zest of 1 lemon, olive oil and salt.Lay over 1kg sliced potatoes tossed in oil in a roasting tin and roast at 220°C for 50 minutes until charred and cooked through.Rest 10 minutes.Mix 200g Greek yoghurt with lemon juice, parsley and mint to serve.SweetsFloating lantern cakesWhole boiled orange and almond meal cakeHow to make it3 oranges6 eggs220g caster sugar1 tsp baking powder250g almond meal3 tbsp honeyBoil 2 whole oranges until very soft.Cool, then blend smooth.Whisk the eggs with the sugar and baking powder.Fold in the orange puree and almond meal.Spoon into muffin tins and bake at 170°C until set.Simmer the juice of the remaining orange with the honey for the syrup and glaze the cakes.DrinksCorona lavender coolerLavender syrup and lemon juice over iceHow to make it150g caster sugar150ml water1 tbsp dried culinary lavender2 lemons800ml soda water4 cups iceSimmer the sugar, water and lavender for a few minutes.Cool and strain.Fill glasses with ice, add syrup and lemon juice to each.Top with soda water.
